sentences.text: The Corruption and Crime Commission examined safeguards against unauthorised access to and disclosure of confidential personal information held by public agencies.
sentences.support: the legislative and policy framework for dealing with unauthorised access and disclosure of confidential personal information

sentences.text: Its work covered laws and policies, staff selection and supervision, and staff awareness, using submissions, agency fieldwork and a staff survey.
sentences.support: Specific information was also gained from several sample agencies, which was tested through fieldwork in those sample agencies.

sentences.text: The Commission concluded that legislation and policy were fragmented and inadequate.
sentences.support: It is this Commission’s opinion that the relevant legislation and policy is inadequate and piecemeal

sentences.text: It also found shortcomings in recruitment checks, training and supervision of staff handling confidential information.
sentences.support: The training and supervision of public sector staff in the requirements to maintain confidentiality in the course of their employment are inadequate.

sentences.text: Its recommendations sought legislative reform, consolidated policies, stronger staff screening and access controls, and induction on information responsibilities.
sentences.support: It is recommended that all agencies re-evaluate their information management systems to ensure that safeguards are in place to mitigate unauthorised access and disclosure

sentences.text: The Commission intended to review progress after about three years.
sentences.support: The Corruption and Crime Commission intends conducting a follow-up review in approximately three years’ time.

findings.quote: It is this Commission’s opinion that the relevant legislation and policy is inadequate and piecemeal, and improvements need to be made to the framework surrounding confidential personal information.
The training and supervision of public sector staff in the requirements to maintain confidentiality in the course of their employment are inadequate.

notes: Recommendations are unnumbered and include subsidiary proposals; no single numerical total is stated.
